elements.vlm_description:
This image is a line graph illustrating the change in temperature over time.

**Chart Details:**

*   **Type:** Line Graph.
*   **Title:** 気温の変化 (Temperature Change).
*   **Y-Axis (Vertical Axis):** Represents temperature in degrees Celsius (℃).
*   **X-Axis (Horizontal Axis):** Represents time, marked by hours ranging from 7時 to 19時.

**Data Points and Trend:**
The graph displays temperature data points plotted across the timeline. The temperature generally increases from the beginning (13.7°C at 7h) to a peak around 14h (23.1°C). After the peak, the temperature fluctuates, generally remaining high before showing a noticeable decline towards the end of the period (dropping to 13.8°C at 19h).
